summary: iter349 backend testing complete — 11/11 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter349_ivr_business_hours.py. Business-hours branch, after-hours branch (verified via monkey-patch), handle-menu press-0/press-1 both routing to +15149490038, and iter347 4-digit extension regression all green. The endpoint /api/twilio/ivr/main-menu now dynamically branches on Montreal (America/Toronto) local time using zoneinfo.ZoneInfo (DST-safe). Response content-type is application/xml; charset=utf-8 and tests correctly use response.content.decode('utf-8').
critical_code_review_comments: handle_menu uses asyncio.create_task inside a nested helper (_log_outcome) to fire-and-forget the Mongo update. This is fine but the task is not awaited, so persistence is best-effort and could race against the test's immediate follow-up read (mitigated in tests by NOT relying on the digit_pressed persistence in every assertion). The route returns before the write completes — acceptable trade-off for latency-sensitive TwiML, but flag for future ops audit.

The business-hours after-hours branch does not return callerId or a fallback support number for the caller — call is intentionally hung up. Aligns with the spec but ensure ops team monitors 'ended_after_hours' outcomes to detect legitimate business calls after hours.

_current_montreal_time falls back to `datetime.now(utc) - timedelta(hours=5)` if zoneinfo import fails. This ignores DST. Not an issue in practice (Python 3.11 has zoneinfo), but the fallback is technically incorrect for EDT (should be -4). Very defensive-only.
File /app/backend/routes/contractor_ivr_inbound.py is 963 lines. Consider splitting IVR routes and SendGrid Inbound Parse into separate modules for maintainability (>700-line guideline).
test_credentials: No credentials needed — IVR endpoints are anonymous. Seeded a dialer_contractor user directly in db.users during test_valid_extension_still_dials_contractor (cleaned up after).
seed_data_creation: Test test_valid_extension_still_dials_contractor seeds a dialer_contractor with extension_number=5432 and personal_phone_number=+15145558877, then deletes it in the finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter349 backend is stable. Live branch at test time was business-hours (Thursday afternoon Montreal). After-hours branch is covered deterministically via monkey-patching routes.contractor_ivr_inbound._current_montreal_time. Both handle-menu digit_pressed=0 and digit_pressed=1 route to BIDVEX_GENERAL_SUPPORT_NUMBER=+15149490038. attempt>=4 fallback dial still works. TwiML responses use content-type application/xml; charset=utf-8 — tests MUST use response.content.decode('utf-8'). /api/feeds/image-diagnostics requires auth (401 without token) — not a regression.
